messages:
sara: Heads-up — around 11:58 local we're seeing repeated p95 east->west latency spikes across rack-mix A3 during the midday batching window. Affects ~6 GPU nodes. RTT jumps from ~350us -> 6-8ms for short bursts, correlates with batch ramp.
matt: ugh. any packet loss or retrans counters? feels like RDMA fallback maybe.
kevin: I see increased retransmits on the mlx5 counters and a bump in `tcp_retrans` in node logs. qdisc shows drops on txq for ifenslaves on those hosts.
sara: paste from one host's netstat/rdma counters:
```
rx_packets: 1254321 tx_packets: 1249987
rdma_retransmits: 432 rdma_errors: 0
ifconfig ens256 mtu: 9000
ethtool -S ens256 | grep tx_err
   tx_err  : 12
   tx_restart  : 7
```
jing: MTU looks fine on the NICs but I notice a mix of 9000 and 8972 in some older hosts (rack migrated last month). Could be off-by-chunk causing frag+coalesce fallback.
sanjay: also saw ECN markings spike in the tc counters — suspect qdisc/queues reshuffle under high batching concurrency. When KV cache warms up, bursts align with the p95 spikes.
infra-bot: New alert: high-p95-ew-latency detected on cluster-east-3 (A3 racks) — incident created #INC-2026-742.
kevin: can someone run a pcap on the host during next ramp? capture small snap for 10s with tcpdump -s 256 -c 2000 -w /tmp/ew-snap.pcap and check for GSO/GRO fragments + PSH bursts.
matt: also check rdma stats with `perfquery` and `ibv_devinfo` to ensure qp state OK. If QP resets are happening we want to see it.
sara: scheduled a small canary now to reproduce — moving 2 test jobs to racks A3-A4, will post pcap link. If this reproduces, we should coordinate a selective reconfig: align MTU, toggle `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1`, and temporarily reduce batch concurrency for A3 pools.
jing: quick workaround idea: enable `ethtool -K ens256 gso off gro off tso off` on affected nodes to avoid jumbo coalescing issues for the short term. Performance hit but reduces retrans.
sanjay: cost tradeoff noted — fewer batches means higher unit GPU cost; but better than tail latencies for users. +1 on trying the `-K` toggle on 2 nodes first.
kevin: logged a runbook step: if enabling GSO/GRO/TSO off doesn't reduce retrans, revert and test `mlxconfig -d /dev/mst/mt4099 set LINK_TYPE_PMA=1` and consult NIC vendor.
sara: link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood-inference.internal/clusters/east-3?panel=ew-latency — reproducing now, will upload pcap to /mnt/ops/snapshots/ew-1719010000.pcap
matt: nice repro, thanks. once we have pcap I'll triage for out-of-order or jumbo fragmentation signatures. Ping me when uploaded.
infra-bot: @sara assigned incident to @matt and @jing. priority: P2.
sara: uploaded pcap: /mnt/ops/snapshots/ew-1719010000.pcap
kevin: downloaded, quick look shows a handful of frames with `ip len` > 8972 and kernel emitting skb_clone warnings in dmesg around the same times.
jing: plan: 1) run GSO/TCO/GRO off on two canaries 2) align MTU on older hosts to 9000 via ansible 3) reduce batch concurrency by 20% on A3 autoscaler until metric stabilizes 4) collect perfquery/ibv logs. I'll take 1&2.
sara: executing 1 now on canary nodes, will watch p95. If stable for 10m we roll to rest.
matt: thanks — if GSO off helps, we'll schedule a kernel/NIC firmware follow-up to address coalescing bug. Also let's open a vendor ticket with the pcap and mlx logs.
kevin: adding note: check if any recent kube-proxy or CNI updates rolled in last 48h — I've seen similar when CNI toggles offload flags.
sanjay: keeping an eye on cost impact for the reduced concurrency; will update finance if >5% uplift in GPU hours.
sara: update in 8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
